messages.content: Claire earns 1 Girl Scout badge and 2 points every month.  It takes Amber twice as long to earn a badge than Claire.  Wendy earns three times the amount of badges as Claire in the same time frame.  How many more badges does Wendy earn compared to Amber in a 1 year time frame?

content.text:
# Solving the Badge Problem

## Setting Up the Information

**Claire's rate:** 1 badge and 2 points every month

**Amber's rate:** Takes twice as long as Claire, so she earns 1 badge every 2 months
- Badges per month: 1/2

**Wendy's rate:** Three times the badges as Claire in the same time frame
- Badges per month: 3

## Calculating Badges in 1 Year (12 months)

**Amber's badges in 1 year:**
$$12 \text{ months} \times \frac{1}{2} \text{ badge/month} = 6 \text{ badges}$$

**Wendy's badges in 1 year:**
$$12 \text{ months} \times 3 \text{ badges/month} = 36 \text{ badges}$$

## Finding the Difference

$$36 - 6 = \boxed{30 \text{ badges}}$$

Wendy earns **30 more badges** than Amber in a 1 year time frame.
